security_history.policy: include historical and delisted securities; never join by name alone

sessions.policy: official verified exchange sessions; timezone-aware; never weekday-only generation

bars.policy: no silent forward fill across suspensions or delistings; record unavailable periods

corporate_actions.policy: point-in-time feature joins; label adjustments use observed realized dividends/splits/settlement

benchmark.policy: same entry/exit timestamps and return adjustment definition as stock

disclosures.policy: retain all revisions; receipt_date without timestamp not enough for intraday availability

consensus.policy: report-quoted consensus is not a live historical consensus feed; separate both

provider_access.KRX_or_licensed_price_vendor: not_connected; usage and redistribution licence required
provider_access.OpenDART: adapter only; no API key; consult API terms and rate limits
